name: Beef bibimbap bowl
steps: Brown the minced beef in a hot pan with a splash of soy sauce until cooked through.
Quickly saute the spinach and grated carrot until just softened.
Warm the rice and arrange it in a bowl.
Lay the beef and vegetables in sections over the rice.
Fry the egg and slide it on top, then add a spoon of gochujang.
